section: Evolution of Panchayati Raj - Community Development Programme, Balwant Rai Mehta, Ashok Mehta, G.V.K. Rao and L.M. Singhvi committees
subsections: National Front government's bill - scope and fate
Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage

accepted.s: Who introduced fresh bills, including a revised Nagarpalika Bill, in September 1990?
accepted.x: The V.P. Singh-led National Front Government introduced fresh bills, including a revised Nagarpalika Bill, in September 1990.
accepted.tq: Use the government-and-year association to distinguish the two stages of the local-government legislation.
accepted.sec: National Front government's bill - scope and fate  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: With reference to the bills introduced by the National Front Government in September 1990, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: They were withdrawn after being converted into the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act.
They were referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee and enacted in 1993.
They were passed by Parliament in December 1992.
They were never passed and lapsed when the Lok Sabha was dissolved.
accepted.x: The bills introduced by the V.P. Singh Government were never passed and lapsed upon the dissolution of the Lok Sabha.
accepted.tq: Find the option that correctly states the fate of the earlier bill instead of confusing it with the later legislation.
accepted.sec: National Front government's bill - scope and fate  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the bills introduced by the P.V. Narasimha Rao Government:
1. The controversial parts of the earlier proposals were removed.
2. Modified Panchayat and Municipality Bills were introduced in September 1991.
3. The bills were referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The P.V. Narasimha Rao Government removed the controversial provisions, introduced modified bills in September 1991, and referred them to a Joint Parliamentary Committee.
accepted.tq: Treat the three statements as a sequence of legislative actions and select the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. The modified Panchayat and Municipality Bills were introduced.
B. The bills introduced by the National Front Government lapsed with the dissolution of the Lok Sabha.
C. The bills were passed by Parliament.
D. The modified bills were referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee.
accepted.x: The National Front bills lapsed after the dissolution of the Lok Sabha; modified bills were introduced in September 1991, referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee, and passed in December 1992.
accepted.tq: Fix the two dated introduction stages first, then place committee reference before parliamentary passage.
accepted.sec: Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The modified Panchayat and Municipality Bills introduced by the P.V. Narasimha Rao Government were passed by Parliament in:
accepted.x: The modified bills, after being referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee, were passed by Parliament in December 1992.
accepted.tq: Separate the date of introduction from the later date of parliamentary passage.
accepted.sec: Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Constitutional Amendment Act)
A. 73rd Amendment Act, 1992
B. 74th Amendment Act, 1992

List-II (Principal addition)
I. Part IXA relating to municipalities
II. Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The 73rd Amendment added Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule, whereas the 74th Amendment added Part IXA dealing with municipalities.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure distinction between Panchayats under Part IX and municipalities under Part IXA.
accepted.sec: Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993.
2. The 74th Amendment came into force on 1 June 1993.
3. Part IXA relating to municipalities was added by the 73rd Amendment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false: Part IXA relating to municipalities was added by the 74th Amendment, while the 73rd Amendment added Part IX and the Eleventh Schedule.
accepted.tq: Use the amendment-to-Part association to detect the reversed constitutional provision.
accepted.sec: Narasimha Rao government's bills - introduction, Joint Committee, passage  [GROUP-II]
